title: How to stop numbers showing as scientific notation (1.23E+11)
task: Show long numbers in full — and know when the real problem is the 15-digit limit.

excel.note: Or format the cell as Number with 0 decimals. For IDs, the real fix is importing the column AS TEXT.

explanation: Scientific notation is just the default DISPLAY for wide numbers — a "0" format (via TEXT or the cell format) shows all the digits: 1.23E+11 becomes 123000000000. The deeper trap: spreadsheets keep only 15 significant digits, so a 16-digit credit-card or barcode number is already silently corrupted (final digit becomes 0) the moment it's entered as a number — no format can bring it back. Long identifiers must be TEXT from the start: import the column as text or prefix entries with an apostrophe.
